reason: Clarify deterministic full-path eligibility and the audited MEXC bulk UTC+08 monthly packaging boundary before any sibling outcome calculation.

clarifications.W1_eligibility: A scored signal is eligible only if its next-bar entry plus the cell's full frozen max-hold duration is strictly before 2025-01-01T00:00:00Z. Later signals are right-censored and never scored.
clarifications.W2_eligibility: Unchanged: full frozen max-hold path must fit strictly before 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z.
clarifications.W3_eligibility: Unchanged: full frozen max-hold path must fit strictly before 2026-08-31T00:00:00Z.
clarifications.bulk_packaging: MEXC monthly files may begin/end at 16:00 UTC because partitions are packaged on UTC+08 calendar boundaries; all research windows and derived 12H/8H/4H bars are canonical UTC and source rows are filtered by their embedded UTC timestamps.
clarifications.duplicate_filename_policy: If duplicate-named source copies are present and SHA256-identical, retain one. Any non-identical duplicate for the same asset/month/timeframe is a source failure before outcomes.
clarifications.derived_bar_policy: A derived bar is retained only when every expected 15-minute timestamp is present exactly once. No fill or interpolation.
